info.name: Panel Atletas
info.description:
API collection for the Panel Atletas platform.

Organized by access level:
- **Auth** — public endpoints, no role required
- **Admin** — requires ADMIN_JWT (role = admin)
- **User** — requires USER_JWT (any authenticated user)

All authenticated requests require a valid JWT in the Authorization header.

variable.description: Publishable API key. Found in Supabase → Project Settings → API.
JWT of an authenticated admin user. Obtain via Auth → Sign In.
JWT of an authenticated regular user. Obtain via Auth → Sign In.
UUID of the target user. Used as a filter in PATCH requests.
Integer ID of a medal row. Used as a filter in PATCH/DELETE medal requests.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public Supabase Auth endpoints. No role required. Used by any user to authenticate or manage their own session.

request.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns access_token (JWT) and refresh_token.
Sends a password reset email to the given address. User clicks the link and is redirected to the app to set a new password.

Updates the authenticated user's password. Used after password recovery or invite flows.

Requires the `access_token` from the recovery/invite link as Bearer token.

**Do not send `email`** — email changes are not supported in this app.
Invalidates all sessions for the user (`scope=global`). Use after password change to force re-login everywhere. Client must discard the stored JWT after this call.

item.name: Admin
item.description:
All endpoints that require an admin JWT (role = admin). Includes Edge Functions and admin-only Data API access.

All requests use {{ADMIN_JWT}}.

request.description:
Invites one or more users by email. Sends a magic link invitation to each address.

**Required fields:**
- `emails` — array of email strings (one or more)
- `initial_role` — one of: `athlete`, `coach`, `admin`

Each email is processed independently. Response includes per-email results:
```json
{ "results": [ { "email": "...", "status": "sent" | "error", "reason": "..." } ] }
```

Fails per-email with reason `Invitation already exists` if active invitation found.

When user clicks magic link, trigger `on_user_email_confirmed` marks invitation as `accepted`.
Resends the magic link to a user with an existing non-accepted invitation. Resets expiry to 7 days from now and increments the attempt counter.
Returns all invitation records. RLS restricts this endpoint to admins only.

item.name: Own Profile
item.description: Admins are also invited users — they must create and manage their own profile the same way athletes do. These endpoints use ADMIN_JWT.

request.description: `id_user` and `role` injected by triggers. Role comes from the accepted invitation — will be `admin` if invited as admin.
Returns the admin's own profile. Note: because admins pass the `is_admin()` check, this returns ALL profiles. Use `id_user=eq.{{USER_ID}}` to filter to their own.
Updates the admin's own profile. Always filter by `id_user=eq.{{USER_ID}}` — without it, the PATCH applies to all visible rows (all profiles for an admin).

item.name: Disciplines
item.description: Admin CRUD for the disciplines catalog.

request.description:
Creates a new discipline.

**Required fields:**
- `name` — VARCHAR(64), must be unique
- `discipline_type` — one of: `sport`, `recreational`

**Optional (defaults to true):**
- `is_active` — BOOLEAN

Deletes a discipline. Blocked by FK constraint if any user has ever been enrolled (enrollment history preserved). To delete, remove all enrollments first.

**Deactivation** (`is_active: false`) is always allowed and is the preferred way to retire a discipline.

Returns active discipline enrollments for a specific user (inactive disciplines excluded).

**Query param:**
- `fk_user=eq.{{USER_ID}}` — filter by target user UUID

Enrolls any user in a discipline.

**Required fields:**
- `fk_user` — UUID of the target user
- `fk_discipline` — integer ID of the discipline

**Optional:**
- `is_representative` — boolean, default `false`. Only valid for sport disciplines — trigger blocks `true` for recreational disciplines.

Blocked if discipline is inactive.

Updates a user's enrollment. Typically used to toggle `is_representative`.

**Filter by** `id_user_discipline` (enrollment row ID).

Removes a user's enrollment from a discipline.

**Filter by** `id_user_discipline` (enrollment row ID).

item.name: Register Admin
item.description: Create a fully registered admin user in one call. Admin only.

request.description:
Creates a fully registered admin in one atomic call. Admin only.

Internally: creates `auth.users` → sets `app_metadata.role = admin` → runs `admin_register_admin_transaction` RPC (inserts users_invitations + users_profiles). On failure, deletes auth user.

**Required fields:**
- `email` — unique email address
- `password` — min 6 chars
- `name`, `first_last_name` — VARCHAR(64)
- `dni_type` — `cedula` | `dimex` | `pasaporte`
- `dni` — VARCHAR(32), must be unique
- `birth_date` — DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `sex` — `male` | `female`

**Optional:**
- `second_last_name` — VARCHAR(64)

**Response (201):** `{ success: true, user_id, email }`

item.name: Profiles
item.description: Admin access to all user profiles. RLS allows admins to read and update any profile.

request.description: Returns all user profiles. RLS restricts this to admins only.

Updates any user's profile. Intended for admin operations like changing roles.

**role** — one of: `athlete`, `admin`. Only admins can change this field.

**is_active cannot be changed here** — use the `Block / Unblock User` endpoint instead.

Activates or deactivates a user. Simultaneously updates `users_profiles.is_active` and bans/unbans the user in Supabase Auth.

**Required fields:**
- `user_id` — UUID of the target user
- `is_active` — `true` to activate, `false` to deactivate

`is_active: false` → sets `ban_duration: '876600h'` (permanent ban). User cannot log in.
`is_active: true` → sets `ban_duration: 'none'`. Restores login access.

Admin cannot change their own active status. Last active admin is protected by `protect_last_admin` trigger.

Permanently deletes a non-admin user. Cascades automatically:
- `users_profiles` — FK CASCADE
- `athletes` — FK CASCADE
- `users_disciplines` — FK CASCADE
- `medals` — FK CASCADE
- `users_invitations` — trigger `delete_invitation_on_user_delete`

**Required fields:**
- `user_id` — UUID of the target user

Blocked if target user is an admin. Admin cannot delete their own account.

⚠️ Irreversible.

request.description:
Creates a fully registered athlete in a single atomic transaction. Admin only.

Internally: creates `auth.users` → sets `app_metadata` → runs `admin_register_athlete_transaction` RPC (inserts users_invitations, users_profiles, athletes, users_disciplines, medals). On any failure, deletes the auth user to avoid orphans.

**Required fields:**
- `email` — unique email address
- `password` — min 6 chars
- `name`, `first_last_name` — VARCHAR(64)
- `dni_type` — `cedula` | `dimex` | `pasaporte`
- `dni` — VARCHAR(32), must be unique
- `birth_date` — DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `sex` — `male` | `female`
- `phone` — VARCHAR(64)
- `district_of_residence` — `san_pedro` | `sabanilla` | `mercedes` | `san_rafael` | `other`
- `weekly_exercise` — integer 1–7
- `satisfaction_level` — `very_satisfied` | `satisfied` | `neutral` | `dissatisfied`
- `facility_satisfaction_level` — `yes` | `no` | `partial`
- `accepts_data_usage` — must be `true`
- `accepts_info_accuracy` — must be `true`
- `discipline_names` — non-empty array of existing discipline names

**Optional:**
- `second_last_name` — VARCHAR(64)
- `legal_guardian_name` + `legal_guardian_phone` — required if athlete is under 18 (trigger enforces)
- `nacional_games_participation`, `international_games_participation` — boolean, default `false`
- `has_family_support`, `has_family_in_committee` — boolean, default `false`
- `has_previous_committee` + `previous_committee_name` — boolean + VARCHAR
- `is_club_member` + `club_name` — boolean + VARCHAR
- `has_disability` + `disability_type` (`physical` | `cognitive`) + `disability_description`
- `has_functional_classification` + `classification_category` (`a1`|`a2`|`b1`|`b2`|`c1`|`c2`)
- `is_representative` — boolean, default `false`. Only valid for sport disciplines.
- `medals` — array of `{ competition_name, year, medal_type }`. `medal_type`: `gold` | `silver` | `bronze`.

**Response (201):** `{ success: true, user_id, email }`
Returns all athlete records. RLS restricts this to admins only.
Updates any athlete record. Admin only per RLS.
Deletes an athlete record. Admin only per RLS. The athlete's profile in users_profiles is NOT deleted — only the athletes row.

item.name: User
item.description:
Endpoints accessible by any authenticated user. RLS enforces that each user can only read and modify their own data.

All requests use {{USER_JWT}}.

item.name: Catalog
item.description: Read-only catalog tables. Any authenticated user can read these. Data is managed via migrations, not through the API.

request.description: Returns all active disciplines. Used to populate the discipline selector during enrollment.

item.name: Profiles
item.description: Read and manage the authenticated user's own profile.

request.description:
Creates the profile for the authenticated user. `id_user` and `role` are injected automatically by triggers — do not send them in the body.

**All fields are NOT NULL.** All must be provided:
- `name` — VARCHAR(64)
- `first_last_name` — VARCHAR(64)
- `second_last_name` — VARCHAR(64)
- `dni_type` — one of: `cedula`, `dimex`, `pasaporte`
- `dni` — VARCHAR(32), must be unique
- `birth_date` — DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `sex` — one of: `male`, `female`
- `profile_image_url` — TEXT, nullable

Called once after the user first signs in via invitation link.
Returns the authenticated user's own profile. RLS filters automatically — no id filter needed.
Updates the authenticated user's own profile. RLS blocks updates to other users' profiles. The `role` field cannot be changed by regular users — only admins can update it.

request.description:
`id_user` is injected automatically by the `set_athlete_id_from_auth` trigger — do not send it in the body.

**All fields are NOT NULL.** Only the following are nullable due to conditional constraints:
- `legal_guardian_name` + `legal_guardian_phone` — null when athlete is ≥ 18, required when under 18 (trigger enforces against birth_date in users_profiles)
- `previous_committee_name` — null when `has_previous_committee = false`, required when `true`
- `club_name` — null when `is_club_member = false`, required when `true`
- `disability_type` + `disability_description` — null when `has_disability = false`, required when `true`. Values: `physical`, `cognitive`
- `classification_category` + `classification_document_url` — null when `has_functional_classification = false`, required when `true`. Values: `a1`, `a2`, `b1`, `b2`, `c1`, `c2`

**Required fields:**
- `phone` — VARCHAR(64)
- `district_of_residence` — one of: `san_pedro`, `sabanilla`, `mercedes`, `san_rafael`, `other`
- `weekly_exercise` — SMALLINT 1–7
- `satisfaction_level` — one of: `very_satisfied`, `satisfied`, `neutral`, `dissatisfied`
- `facility_satisfaction_level` — one of: `yes`, `no`, `partial`
- `accepts_data_usage` — must be `true`
- `accepts_info_accuracy` — must be `true`

Boolean flags default to `false`: `nacional_games_participation`, `international_games_participation`, `has_family_support`, `has_family_in_committee`, `has_previous_committee`, `is_club_member`, `has_disability`, `has_functional_classification`
Returns the athlete record for the authenticated user. RLS filters automatically.
Updates the authenticated user's own athlete record. RLS blocks updates to other users' records.

item.name: Disciplines
item.description: Manage the authenticated user's discipline enrollments (users_disciplines table).

request.description: Returns active discipline enrollments for the authenticated user. Inactive disciplines excluded. RLS filters to own enrollments automatically.

`fk_user` is injected automatically by the `set_discipline_user_from_auth` trigger — do not send it in the body.

**Required fields:**
- `fk_discipline` — INTEGER, id of the discipline

**Optional (defaults to false):**
- `is_representative` — BOOLEAN. Only relevant for `sport` disciplines. Automatically forced to `false` for `recreational` disciplines by DB trigger.

Fails with a unique constraint error if the user is already enrolled in the same discipline.
Updates a discipline enrollment. RLS blocks updates to enrollments belonging to other users.
Removes a discipline enrollment. RLS blocks deletion of enrollments belonging to other users.

item.name: Medals
item.description: Manage the authenticated user's own medal records.

request.description: Returns all medals for the authenticated user. RLS filters automatically.

Creates a medal record for the authenticated user. `id_user` must match the authenticated user's UUID — RLS rejects any mismatch.

**Required fields (all):**
- `id_user` — UUID, must equal auth.uid()
- `competition_name` — VARCHAR(64)
- `year` — SMALLINT
- `medal_type` — one of: `gold`, `silver`, `bronze`

No nullable fields in this table.
Updates a medal record. RLS blocks updates to medals belonging to other users.
Deletes a medal record. RLS blocks deletion of medals belonging to other users.
